title: RES↔DEVOPS-001: Specialized Build Environments + Infrastructure for Research Prototypes
description: The Researcher provides specialized build/toolchain requirements (non-standard compilers, SDKs, build tools), research infrastructure needs (compute, storage, networking, specialized hardware), fleet-data-access requirements (with justification and intended use), and containerization requirements for reproducible environments; the DevOps/Platform Engineer provides build-environment feasibility, infrastructure-requirements assessment, reproducible research-environment support, and fleet-data-access infrastructure within the security-baseline constraints. Grounded in IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6.12. Fleet production-data access requires approval by the Security Engineer AND the Product Owner/TPM — that branch is a security touchpoint and escalates ESC-SEC.

research_infra_requirements.description: RES→DEVOPS: toolchain, compute/storage/networking, containerization, and fleet-data-access requests.

fleet_data_access.description: Access to production fleet data for field-data-driven research (security-gated).

security_approval_ref.description: Security Engineer approval reference (required when requested = true).

po_approval_ref.description: Product Owner/TPM approval reference (required when requested = true).

devops_feasibility.description: DEVOPS→RES: build/infrastructure feasibility and reproducibility support.

complexity.description: STANDARD → 10 business days; COMPLEX → 20 business days.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine build-environment / infrastructure feasibility for research prototypes is agent-autonomous (build feasibility within 10 business days; infra assessment 10 standard / 20 complex business days). The fleet-data-access branch touches the security baseline — it requires Security Engineer AND Product Owner/TPM approval and escalates ESC-SEC; agents may only propose on that branch.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER + CALENDAR (build-environment feasibility within 10 business days; infrastructure needs within 10 (standard) / 20 (complex) business days; fleet-data access provisioned within 10 business days of an approved request; annual Research-Infrastructure Planning, first Tuesday of October)
confirm_conditions: the build-environment and infrastructure feasibility verdicts are stated with a response time
containerization for reproducible research environments is addressed where required
a fleet-data-access request carries justification, intended use, AND both the Security Engineer and Product Owner/TPM approval references
infrastructure complexity (standard vs. complex) is classified so the correct SLA applies
reject_conditions: fleet production-data access provisioned without both Security Engineer and Product Owner/TPM approval (security baseline — ESC-SEC; HITL-gated)
research fleet-data access granted outside the security-baseline constraints (e.g., un-minimized PII) — escalate
an UNSUPPORTED build requirement presented as ready-to-run without the required pipeline changes (Honesty §10.3)
counter_conditions: a specialized toolchain lacks a reproducibility package — request a containerization spec before provisioning
an infrastructure request is complex/specialized — flag the 20-business-day assessment path and request the full spec
